'If this was played from arsenal, it gains +1{p}.' Same text as the red/blue printings; identical shape to .drafts/burgeoning_red.json.

Pump shape per DSL_REFERENCE: TRIGGERED + ON_ATTACK + MODIFY_ATTACK - an Action - Attack card is NOT an ATTACK_REACTION, and that ability type would never fire. Verified against handlers, not just the sibling: PLAYED_FROM_ARSENAL exists (condition_types.py:789), reads played_from_zone stamped by play.py at the moment of play with a prev_zone fallback, and its own comment says the two agree on the arsenal -> combat-chain move, so the gate is true exactly when this copy was played from arsenal. Ability-level conditions are checked at resolution, after the stamp exists. A hand play leaves the gate false, matching the release note ('You may still play Burgeoning from your hand. It would not gain the +1{p}.'). MODIFY_ATTACK reads mod/amount (effect_types.py:4123-4125) and records on combat.power_mods so the +1 survives later recalculations rather than being a one-off bump.

printed_keywords is empty, so no conditional-keyword machinery applies.
